_readme: Runtime configuration for the Payana web app. This file is fetched when the app starts,
so it can be edited on the server WITHOUT rebuilding the app.
GOOGLE ANALYTICS / GOOGLE ADS: the easiest place to add your account IDs is the
admin console -> Settings -> Analytics & Ads. Values saved there win. The 'analytics'
block below is the fallback, used for any ID left empty in the admin console and
whenever the API cannot be reached. Leave an ID as an empty string to keep that
integration switched off: no Google script is requested and nothing is sent.
None of these values is a secret. Never put passwords or API secrets in this file.
